findings.claim: Comfort Systems USA (NYSE: FIX) acquired Feyen Zylstra Holdings, LLC (electrical design/install/maintenance for industrial, technology and healthcare clients, Michigan-based) and Meisner Electric, Inc. findings.source: Tracxn — List of 21 Acquisitions by Comfort Systems USA (Aug 2026); corroborated by Comfort Systems 8-K filings (SEC EDGAR CIK 1035983, filing accession 000110465925101818, dated 2025-10-23)

findings.claim: Comfort Systems USA integrated Right Way Plumbing and Mechanical (mechanical services) into its operations effective May 1, 2025, as part of its bolt-on M&A strategy; the company completed a total of five acquisitions during 2025.
findings.source: Yahoo Finance — "Could Comfort Systems' Acquisitions Fuel a Multi-Year Rally?"

findings.claim: A former Comfort Systems USA employee filed a proposed ERISA class action on February 4, 2026 in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Texas, alleging the company's 401(k) plan retained a risky, underperforming stable-value/guaranteed-income fund from Empower Annuity Insurance Co. (holding over $100 million in plan assets as of 2023) that let Empower earn excessive profits at participants' expense. This is a retirement-plan fiduciary-duty suit, not a securities-fraud class action against FIX stock.
findings.source: Bloomberg Law — "Comfort Systems Sued Over 401(k) Plan's Stable Value Investment"

findings.claim: Industry-wide (not FIX-specific): a report finds nearly half of U.S. data centers scheduled for completion in 2026 face delays or cancellation, driven by permitting bottlenecks, power-grid shortfalls, and community resistance — a backdrop risk to FIX's data-center-driven backlog (backlog was $12.45B per Q1 2026 report vs $6.89B a year earlier).
findings.source: MSN/wire report — "Report: Nearly 1/2 of U.S. data centers due in 2026 face delays or cancelation"; backlog figures via Seeking Alpha coverage of Comfort Systems Q1 2026 results
